description: This file defines the ReportToDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. It serves as a decorator for the ReportTo entity, providing methods to set supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method by their respective IDs, utilizing traits and references to other entities such as Employee and ReportingMethod.

classes.name: ReportToDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ReportTo entity, providing methods to associate employees and reporting methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a ReportTo entity instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportTo
methods.description: Retrieves the wrapped ReportTo entity instance.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the supervisor employee in the ReportTo entity using an employee number.

methods.name: setSubordinateEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the subordinate employee in the ReportTo entity using an employee number.

methods.name: setReportingMethodByReportingMethodId
methods.description: Sets the reporting method in the ReportTo entity using a reporting method ID.
